catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ardagh: This 1913 reference article on Ardagh — the Irish diocese of St. Mel. James Ryan gives its ancient story. Its bishops date from Patrick's age. The midlands keep its old name. A see of the Irish plain. Its round tower guards the churchyard.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-armagh: This 1913 reference piece on Armagh — the primatial see of all Ireland. Ambrose Coleman honors St. Patrick's foundation. Its archbishops lead the Irish Church. The Troubles tested its shepherds. Erin's ecclesiastical capital. Its twin cathedrals crown the hill. Its book of Armagh is famed.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-benedict-of-p: This 1913 reference piece on Benedict of Peterborough — the chronicler abbot. J. Vincent Crowne honors his Gesta. His pages lit Henry II's reign. The entry preserves his modest fame. A monk among chroniclers. His abbey kept the chronicle's manuscript.
